Amazing late night restaurant
Oct 2026 • Couples
We were looking for a restaurant open until late as our one-day Halong Bay Tour ended at night and we returned to Hanoi around 9:30pm. We ended up in this restaurant and weren't disappointed at all. The food was excellent; we ordered pho and grilled fish and a couple of appetizers and ended up happily satisfied. Our server, Van, was very helpful teaching us how to prepare springrolls and how to eat the fish. She has a very sunny disposition. Our food was served quickly and it tasted amazingly. All in all, we're happy we came here. So if you're looking for a spot that is open until midnight and offers tasty Vietnamese meals, this place is it.

Excellent food, lovely staff, and a special thank you to Kim
Jun 2026 • Couples
We discovered this place when we first arrived in Vietnam, and we enjoyed the experience so much that we came back seven weeks later, just before taking our return flight.

The food is simply delicious: tasty, generous dishes, prepared with great care. The welcome is just as remarkable, with staff who are always attentive and smiling.

A very special thank you to Kim, the young woman who welcomes you at the entrance. She is absolutely lovely: always smiling, naturally kind, and truly helpful when it comes to recommending dishes. She does everything she can to make sure you have a wonderful time, with a sincerity that is really heartwarming.

We appreciated her so much that, if it were possible, we would take her back with us to France! 😉

A wonderful place that we highly recommend.

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Review for Old’s Viet Restaurant
Apr 2026 • Solo
I had an excellent experience at Old’s Viet Restaurant in Hanoi’s Old Quarter. The location is perfect—just steps from Hoàn Kiếm Lake—and the atmosphere is both cozy and authentic, with a nice balance between traditional Vietnamese style and a comfortable, modern dining space.

The food was outstanding. Everything tasted fresh, well-prepared, and full of flavor. There’s a great variety on the menu, including classic Vietnamese dishes as well as vegetarian options, so it’s easy to find something for everyone. The portions were generous and the prices felt very reasonable for the quality. ￼

What really made the experience stand out, though, was the service—especially from our waitress, Kim. She was incredibly friendly, attentive, and genuinely helpful. She took the time to explain the dishes and even showed us how to properly enjoy certain Vietnamese foods, which made the experience feel more authentic and memorable. 

Overall, this was one of the best dining experiences I’ve had in Hanoi. Great food, great atmosphere, and exceptional service. I highly recommend this place to anyone visiting the city—and if you’re lucky enough to have Kim as your waitress, you’re in good hands.
